Container.Name: mokuro-bunko-lite
Container.Overview: Mokuro Bunko (lite): self-hosted manga library server for Mokuro Reader (WebDAV, catalog, accounts) in a ~10 MB image. No local OCR: OCR is done by mokuro-bunko processors on other machines. The image has no shell or nginx. First admin: the log prints a one-time setup code for http://[IP]:[PORT]/setup, or fill in Admin username and Admin password. Tags: beta-lite (the default while 0.7 is in beta) follows the newest release; latest-lite follows stable releases from 0.7.0 on.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID to run as (Unraid nobody=99)

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID to run as (Unraid users=100)

Config.Name: TAKE_OWNERSHIP
Config.Description: Set true to chown /data and /config to PUID:PGID on boot

Config.Name: Admin username
Config.Description: Optional: create this admin account on the first start (ignored once an admin exists). Leave empty to create it in the browser at /setup with the one-time setup code from the container's log.

Config.Name: Admin password
Config.Description: Optional: the password for Admin username (at least 8 characters; only used on the first start).

Config.Name: OCR Generations
Config.Description: Leave empty to use config.yaml, or the JSON list of OCR generations (run by remote processors). Engines: hayai-nova, paddle-manga, ppocr-manga.
